critical_path: This is a structural route, not a claimed measured longest path: gate-baseline-freeze -> relevant gate-legal-audit instance -> required gate-upstream-seam instance -> actual accepted upstream landing (external) -> affected seam implementation/packaging (external) -> gate-source-assembly -> gate-final-zero -> gate-final-platform-proofs -> gate-candidate-freeze.
Candidate fan-out join: gate-candidate-freeze -> max completion of gate-source-erp, gate-source-tractor, gate-update-acceptance -> gate-publication.
Published fan-out join: gate-publication -> max completion of gate-published-erp, gate-published-consumers -> gate-closeout.

The slower actual component/update/mandatory-retirement handoff may dominate instead of upstream review. Independent audit shards, lawful existing-seam implementations, checker preparation and fixture preparation do not wait on unrelated upstream landings.

On one shared host, ERP/Tractor default-port mutex contention contributes real elapsed time even without a semantic DAG edge. Separate genuinely isolated supported hosts can remove that resource bottleneck; local config shims cannot.
notes: Planning artifact only. Nodes describe future authorized execution; this turn does not implement, submit upstream, merge, publish, mutate br or launch workers.

The source_plans values name the existing um-zero slugs. Parameterized nodes are templates: final graph expansion gives each shard/seam a distinct node and dependency only on its exact packet. Colon-qualified instance dependencies must be resolved to concrete node IDs by the integrating planner.

The small root freezes refs and emits raw inventories. Full per-file legal classification and capacity allocation fan out; neither all 447 audits nor every seam decision is a global source-start barrier.

Checker/provenance preparation uses fixture repositories before upstream landings exist. Only the final accounting node may apply a live reviewed transition after genuine upstream incorporation. One boundary-governance owner controls checker/provenance code and both allowance files; integration alone owns FORK-DIVERGENCE.md, package/shared cohort files and generated lockfile changes.

Do not grant wildcard source ownership from placeholders. Reserved targets require exact file reservations before implementation; existing component files stay with component owners. All named artifact roots must be unique and outside other agents' resources.

Fixture preparation and local package rehearsals establish readiness only. Authoritative quality checks require the complete final ref; acceptance requires immutable candidate bytes; published acceptance requires exact registry bytes. Source/package drift invalidates dependent evidence.

gate-final-platform-proofs expands independent Linux/Windows/macOS jobs only when actual isolated runners exist and each OS obligation is justified by the contract. Missing required environments are explicit blockers, never paper parallelism or silent skips.

The existing ERP and Tractor full drivers each cover Node and workerd. Do not split each full suite into duplicate runtime labels. Encode one shared default-port mutex per host; pure update/fixture work can run while it is held, and runtime update phases acquire it when they conflict.

Canonical Tractor must be updated and validated when present. A present busy repository is a lease blocker, not permission to replace its required proof with a private clone. Reviewed private fallback applies only to actual absence.

Publication is a real join on source ERP, source Tractor and two-transition update acceptance, plus actual incorporated upstream landings and still-valid final source qualification. External upstream review delays remain visible; release never completes with mandatory historical debt.

No allowance reset, alternate canonical scope/base, audited-identity rename laundering, import indirection, package alias or app/config shim counts as a repair. Same-contract updates require zero consumer TS/JS/deployment-config edits and zero manual repair; fresh apps retain native entrypoints/data but no copied runtime/checker implementation.
Future task tracking uses br with existing historical modernjs-piop as the zero-debt milestone; parent program/closeout are evidence joins rather than runnable umbrella workers.
